title: Chemical degradation as an enabling pathway to polymersome functionalization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4693-4700
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08536A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chenyu Lin, Kumar Siddharth, Juan Pérez-Mercader
Factors like nature of the m-RAFT, oxygen, and temperature are crucial in chemical degradation, which functionalizes the polymersomes, allowing them to manifest Phoenix dynamics, whereby they exhibit growth-implosion cycles and population growth.
